description: List every privacy and AI framework LexVibe generates documents against — 55 laws across 46 jurisdictions, including GDPR, ePrivacy, the EU AI Act, UK GDPR and PECR, Swiss nFADP, 17 US state privacy laws modelled individually (CCPA/CPRA among them), PIPEDA and Quebec Law 25, LGPD and other LatAm regimes, APPI, PIPA, PDPA, Australia's Privacy Act, India's DPDP, China's PIPL, Saudi and UAE PDPL, POPIA and more. Each entry carries its id, jurisdiction, effective date and official-text URL. Optionally filter by market pack or by jurisdiction. Read-only, instant.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction id to filter by, e.g. "us-tx", "br", "eu".

market.description: Optional market pack to filter by (eu, uk, us, latam, apac…).
